title: Solar Distributor Landing Page
audience: Solar distributors, dealers and EPC installers

hero.title: Solar modules and storage packages for distributor channels.
hero.description: A focused landing page for high-intent Google Ads traffic. It connects product ranges, system packages, proof points and RFQ tracking into one conversion path.
hero.imageAlt: Solar modules and storage system package for distributors

painPoints.title: Hard to compare product families
painPoints.description: The page highlights product ranges, specs and downloads so buyers can quickly qualify fit.

painPoints.title: Project conversations lack standard packages
painPoints.description: Recommended solutions give sales teams a repeatable BOM reference for ads and follow-up.

painPoints.title: Ad leads need source tracking
painPoints.description: The form reserves UTM, referrer and landing page fields for CRM integration.

valueProps.title: Product + system path
valueProps.description: Move visitors from modules to full system packages without sending them through a generic homepage.

valueProps.title: Campaign-specific messaging
valueProps.description: Each ad group can have its own landing page, headline, CTA and noindex/canonical setting.

valueProps.title: Conversion event ready
valueProps.description: Landing form submit, CTA click and download events are prepared for GTM/GA4/Google Ads.

offerCards.title: Standard solar modules
offerCards.description: 450W, 580W and 620W module families for commercial and distributor conversations.

offerCards.title: Off-grid packages
offerCards.description: 6.5kW and 10kW references for remote power, home storage and small commercial needs.

offerCards.title: Grid-tied storage
offerCards.description: 12kW / 28kWh reference package for sales discussion and BOM qualification.
